meta.description: Per-item program reach for the Colorado volume (docs/reviews/cross-program-primitives.md). read_by_programs: the program families whose outcomes read the item, descending only through items of the outcome's own program and shared (All) items; reach_transitive also descends through other programs' items. Families: SNAP, MAGI_CHP (MAGI Medicaid and CHP+), NonMAGI, Medicaid (Medicaid-wide outcomes: verification, emergency Medicaid, BCCP, needy young person), AF, CW, CCCAP, LEAP, SUNBUCKS. home_program: the item's own family (All for shared items). class: the rubric class for a shared item (primitive, clean derivation, grey, program-local); otherwise program-local, neutral, one reader, or unread.
